title: Open WebUI terminal file-preview -- T1059.007 iframe grants allow-same-origin with allow-scripts
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70486 (GHSA-3xpf-xq7r-v8c5,
CVSS 8.2 HIGH), affecting Open WebUI from 0.9.0 until 0.11.0.

The terminal file-preview feature's `serveUrl` iframe branch always
granted BOTH `allow-same-origin` and `allow-scripts` sandbox attributes
for HTML files served from the application's own origin -- a
combination the iframe sandbox specification itself warns defeats
origin isolation, since script running with `allow-same-origin` can
read/manipulate the parent origin's storage. Any authenticated user
with access to a configured terminal server could preview a
self-crafted HTML file through this path, causing embedded script to
execute IN THE OPEN WEBUI ORIGIN -- reading the victim's session token
from `localStorage` and taking over their account, with the
possibility of server-side code execution if the victim held
administrator privileges or `workspace.functions` access.

Detection logic flags the resulting host-observable artifact: a
terminal file-preview request whose target is an HTML file (by
extension or content-type) served through the `serveUrl` path -- the
vulnerable code granted the dangerous sandbox combination
unconditionally for exactly this file type, so any HTML preview through
this route on an unpatched deployment IS the exposure, not merely a
precursor to it.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact PR), fixed in 0.11.0.
